label: copy-phase timing unit: late copy steps of very short sequences (L=3 all, L=4 3rd output), plus sparse firing around absolute t=11-13 in long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or the <DEL> step, never on recall_idx 0). Strongest and most reliable on very short sequences: every copy step after the first output in L=3 sequences (precision 1.0 on dev; the top activations are all L=3, final step, outputting the 3rd token), and the 3rd output (recall_idx 2, t=6) of L=4 sequences; L<=4 & recall_idx==2 alone has dev precision 0.87 and ~40% of activation mass. In longer sequences (L>=6) it fires weakly and unreliably at absolute steps t~11-13 (mid/late copy, recall_idx 2-5), with only ~15-30% of such steps active and no clear token rule (mild preference for some in/out tokens like c, j, g, 0). Almost silent for L=5 and on to_go >= 6. Magnitude: largest on the final step of L=3 sequences; long-sequence firings are small. The predicate captures ~88% of activation mass on dev but has low precision (~0.27), driven by the long-sequence clause.
